role: Tile entity tick probe: builds a slot grid of every tile entity class whose updateEntity changes server state (furnaces with every fuel, daylight detectors through a sunset, hoppers, single/double/trapped chests, beacons on pyramids, note blocks, spawners, brewing stands, ender chests, enchanting tables, one finishing piston) in raw chunks, then runs the tile entity half of World.updateEntities verbatim per tick, recording block writes, changed canonical NBT, walk order, chunk FNV hashes and the StrictMath.cos-derived skylight and celestial angle table.
used_by: oracle/Makefile run target (make -C oracle run CLASS=TileTickProbe), dispatched by Oracle.java's {"cmd":"run","class":...}

csrc/tests/test_tileticks.c (reads out/java/tileticks/full2-v2 and full42-v2: manifest.json, build.bin.gz, init.jsonl.gz, ticks.bin, writes.bin.gz, nbt.jsonl.gz, order.bin.gz, chunkhash.bin.gz, final.bin.gz)
csrc/engine/tileticks.c and csrc/engine/tileticks.h (the native pass, documented against this probe)
notes: Runs on its own OTHER-role thread while the server is parked, uses Probe.rawChunks and Rows.onBlock. No oracle/src file references the class (grep). Recording dirs were listed, not opened.
